scripts/install.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# install.sh — Install local dual-orchestrator command wrappers.
#
# This is the first open-source-friendly installer. It builds the CLI/server
# jars, copies them under a user-writable prefix, and writes small wrapper
# scripts. It does not require root and does not modify shell profiles.
#
# Usage:
#   ./scripts/install.sh
#   ./scripts/install.sh --prefix "$HOME/.local"
#   ./scripts/install.sh --skip-build
#   ./scripts/install.sh --dry-run
#

set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
PREFIX="${DUAL_PREFIX:-$HOME/.local}"
SKIP_BUILD=false
INSTALL_SERVER=true
DRY_RUN=false
CONFIGURE_ACPX=false

CLI_JAR="$PROJECT_ROOT/dual-cli/target/dual-cli-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar"
SERVER_JAR="$PROJECT_ROOT/dual-server/target/dual-server-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar"

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage:
  install.sh [options]

Options:
  --prefix <path>   Install prefix. Default: $DUAL_PREFIX or $HOME/.local
  --skip-build      Reuse existing target jars instead of running Maven.
  --no-server       Install only dualctl, not dual-server.
  --configure-acpx  Write a pinned acpx Codex adapter command into ~/.acpx/config.json.
  --dry-run         Print planned actions without writing files.
  -h, --help        Show this help.

Installed files:
  <prefix>/bin/dualctl
  <prefix>/bin/dual-server       unless --no-server
  <prefix>/lib/dual-orchestrator/dual-cli.jar
  <prefix>/lib/dual-orchestrator/dual-server.jar
EOF
}

log() {
  printf '[INSTALL] %s\n' "$*"
}

warn() {
  printf '[INSTALL][WARN] %s\n' "$*" >&2
}

fail() {
  printf '[INSTALL][FAIL] %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 1
}

run() {
  if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == true ]]; then
    printf '[INSTALL][DRY-RUN] %q' "$1"
    shift
    for arg in "$@"; do
      printf ' %q' "$arg"
    done
    printf '\n'
    return 0
  fi
  "$@"
}

abs_path() {
  local path="$1"
  if [[ "$path" = /* ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$path"
  else
    printf '%s/%s\n' "$(pwd)" "$path"
  fi
}

parse_args() {
  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --prefix)
        shift
        PREFIX="${1:-}"
        ;;
      --skip-build)
        SKIP_BUILD=true
        ;;
      --no-server)
        INSTALL_SERVER=false
        ;;
      --configure-acpx)
        CONFIGURE_ACPX=true
        ;;
      --dry-run)
        DRY_RUN=true
        ;;
      -h|--help)
        usage
        exit 0
        ;;
      *)
        fail "Unknown argument: $1"
        ;;
    esac
    shift
  done

  [[ -n "$PREFIX" ]] || fail "--prefix cannot be empty"
  PREFIX="$(abs_path "$PREFIX")"
}

require_command() {
  local command_name="$1"
  command -v "$command_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "$command_name is required"
}

check_dependencies() {
  require_command java
  require_command mvn
  require_command git
  if ! command -v acpx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    warn "acpx was not found. dualctl can be installed, but real agent runs will fail until acpx is installed and initialized."
  fi
}

configure_acpx() {
  if [[ "$CONFIGURE_ACPX" != true ]]; then
    return
  fi
  log "Configuring pinned acpx adapter"
  run "$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/configure-acpx.sh"
}

build_jars() {
  if [[ "$SKIP_BUILD" == true ]]; then
    log "Skipping Maven build"
  else
    log "Building dual-cli and dual-server"
    run mvn -f "$PROJECT_ROOT/pom.xml" -pl dual-cli,dual-server -am package
  fi

  [[ -f "$CLI_JAR" ]] || fail "dual-cli jar not found: $CLI_JAR"
  if [[ "$INSTALL_SERVER" == true ]]; then
    [[ -f "$SERVER_JAR" ]] || fail "dual-server jar not found: $SERVER_JAR"
  fi
}

install_jar() {
  local source="$1"
  local target="$2"
  log "Installing $(basename "$target")"
  run mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"
  run cp "$source" "$target"
}

write_wrapper() {
  local target="$1"
  local jar="$2"
  local name="$3"
  log "Writing $name wrapper"
  run mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"
  if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == true ]]; then
    log "Would write $target -> java -jar $jar"
    return
  fi
  cat >"$target" <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
exec java -jar "$jar" "\$@"
EOF
  chmod +x "$target"
}

install_files() {
  local lib_dir="$PREFIX/lib/dual-orchestrator"
  local bin_dir="$PREFIX/bin"
  local installed_cli_jar="$lib_dir/dual-cli.jar"
  local installed_server_jar="$lib_dir/dual-server.jar"

  install_jar "$CLI_JAR" "$installed_cli_jar"
  write_wrapper "$bin_dir/dualctl" "$installed_cli_jar" "dualctl"

  if [[ "$INSTALL_SERVER" == true ]]; then
    install_jar "$SERVER_JAR" "$installed_server_jar"
    write_wrapper "$bin_dir/dual-server" "$installed_server_jar" "dual-server"
  fi
}

print_next_steps() {
  cat <<EOF

Installed dual-orchestrator under:
  $PREFIX

Try:
  $PREFIX/bin/dualctl --help

If $PREFIX/bin is not on PATH, add it to your shell profile:
  export PATH="$PREFIX/bin:\$PATH"

Before real agent runs, verify:
  java -version
  mvn -version
  acpx --version
  $PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/configure-acpx.sh
  $PREFIX/bin/dualctl doctor --workdir /path/to/git/repo
EOF
}

main() {
  parse_args "$@"
  check_dependencies
  build_jars
  install_files
  configure_acpx
  print_next_steps
}

main "$@"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# Mainline Decision Gate parser/validator for mainline stability work.

mainline_decision_gate_field_value() {
  local file="$1"
  local field="$2"
  awk -v field="$field" '
    $0 ~ "^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*" field ":[[:space:]]*" {
      sub("^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*" field ":[[:space:]]*", "")
      print
      exit
    }
  ' "$file"
}

mainline_decision_gate_required_fields() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Target phase
Current phase status
Upstream promotion evidence
Boundary owner
Source of truth being changed or strengthened
Drift path being removed or centralized
Explicit non-goals
Proof required before claiming completion
Remaining gaps that must stay visible
EOF
}

mainline_decision_gate_missing_fields() {
  local file="$1"
  local missing=()
  local field value
  while IFS= read -r field; do
    [[ -n "$field" ]] || continue
    value="$(mainline_decision_gate_field_value "$file" "$field")"
    if [[ -z "$value" || "$value" == "TODO"* || "$value" == "TBD"* ]]; then
      missing+=("$field")
    fi
  done < <(mainline_decision_gate_required_fields)
  if [[ "${#missing[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    local IFS='|'
    printf '%s' "${missing[*]}"
  fi
}

mainline_decision_gate_tradeoff_flags() {
  local file="$1"
  local flags=()
  local value lower
  while IFS= read -r field; do
    [[ -n "$field" ]] || continue
    value="$(mainline_decision_gate_field_value "$file" "$field")"
    lower="$(printf '%s' "$value" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
    if [[ "$field" == "Target phase" \
        && "$lower" != "p0" \
        && "$lower" != "p0.5" \
        && "$lower" != "p1" \
        && "$lower" != "p2" \
        && "$lower" != "p3" ]]; then
      flags+=("$field")
      continue
    fi
    if [[ "$field" == "Target phase" \
        && "$lower" != "p0" \
        && "$lower" != "p0.5" ]]; then
      flags+=("$field")
      continue
    fi
    if [[ "$field" == "Current phase status" \
        && "$lower" != "implemented" \
        && "$lower" != "verified" \
        && "$lower" != "promoted" ]]; then
      flags+=("$field")
      continue
    fi
    if [[ "$field" == "Upstream promotion evidence" ]]; then
      local phase
      phase="$(printf '%s' "$(mainline_decision_gate_field_value "$file" "Target phase")" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
      if [[ "$phase" == "p1" || "$phase" == "p2" || "$phase" == "p3" ]]; then
        if [[ "$lower" != *promoted* \
            || "$lower" != *p0* \
            || "$lower" != *p0.5* ]]; then
          flags+=("$field")
          continue
        fi
      elif [[ "$phase" == "p0.5" ]]; then
        if [[ "$lower" != *promoted* || "$lower" != *p0* ]]; then
          flags+=("$field")
          continue
        fi
      fi
    fi
    if [[ "$field" == "Drift path being removed or centralized" \
        && ( "$lower" == "none" \
          || "$lower" == "n/a" \
          || "$lower" == "na" \
          || "$lower" == "no drift" \
          || "$lower" == "not applicable" ) ]]; then
      flags+=("$field")
      continue
    fi
    if [[ "$lower" == *warning* \
        || "$lower" == *prompt* \
        || "$lower" == *fallback* \
        || "$lower" == *measure_only* \
        || "$lower" == *record_only* \
        || "$lower" == *"trace only"* \
        || "$lower" == *"display only"* \
        || "$lower" == *兼容* \
        || "$lower" == *再跑一次* \
        || "$lower" == *看看* \
        || "$lower" == *先观察* \
        || "$lower" == *trade-off* ]]; then
      flags+=("$field")
    fi
  done < <(mainline_decision_gate_required_fields)
  if [[ "${#flags[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    local IFS='|'
    printf '%s' "${flags[*]}"
  fi
}

mainline_decision_gate_is_complete() {
  local file="$1"
  [[ -f "$file" ]] || return 1
  [[ -z "$(mainline_decision_gate_missing_fields "$file")" ]]
  [[ -z "$(mainline_decision_gate_tradeoff_flags "$file")" ]]
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# Shared real-case benchmark grading helpers.
#
# The grading is intentionally small and deterministic. It summarizes lifecycle
# health for benchmark comparison; it does not replace reading the detailed run
# report when a case fails or returns PASS-WARN.

real_case_grade() {
  local status="$1"
  local repo_clean="$2"
  local missing_artifacts="$3"
  local acceptance_decisions="$4"
  local rejects="$5"
  local invalid_reason="${6:-}"

  if [[ -n "$invalid_reason" ]]; then
    printf 'INVALID'
  elif [[ "$status" != "COMPLETED" ]]; then
    printf 'FAIL'
  elif [[ "$repo_clean" != "true" ]]; then
    printf 'FAIL'
  elif [[ -n "$missing_artifacts" ]]; then
    printf 'FAIL'
  elif [[ "$acceptance_decisions" == *"ACCEPT_WITH_NOTES"* ]]; then
    printf 'PASS-WARN'
  elif [[ "$rejects" -gt 0 ]]; then
    printf 'PASS-WARN'
  else
    printf 'PASS'
  fi
}

real_case_grade_reason() {
  local status="$1"
  local repo_clean="$2"
  local missing_artifacts="$3"
  local acceptance_decisions="$4"
  local rejects="$5"
  local invalid_reason="${6:-}"

  if [[ -n "$invalid_reason" ]]; then
    printf 'invalid=%s' "$invalid_reason"
  elif [[ "$status" != "COMPLETED" ]]; then
    printf 'status=%s' "$status"
  elif [[ "$repo_clean" != "true" ]]; then
    printf 'original_repo_dirty'
  elif [[ -n "$missing_artifacts" ]]; then
    printf 'missing_artifacts=%s' "$missing_artifacts"
  elif [[ "$acceptance_decisions" == *"ACCEPT_WITH_NOTES"* ]]; then
    printf 'accepted_with_notes'
  elif [[ "$rejects" -gt 0 ]]; then
    printf 'repaired_rejects=%s' "$rejects"
  else
    printf 'ok'
  fi
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# Structured INVALID classification for real-case summaries.

real_case_invalid_reason_from_runs_dir() {
  local runs_dir="$1"
  [[ -n "$runs_dir" && -d "$runs_dir" ]] || {
    printf ''
    return
  }

  if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    while IFS= read -r file; do
      if jq -e '
        .. | objects | select(
          .failureReason? == "RECOVERABLE_PROVIDER_CONNECTION_FAILED"
          or .failureSignal? == "PROVIDER_CONNECTION_FAILED"
          or .unavailableReason? == "PROVIDER_CONNECTION_FAILED"
          or .type? == "PROVIDER_CONNECTION_FAILED"
        )
      ' "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        printf 'provider_connection_failed'
        return
      elif jq -e '
        .. | objects | select(
          .failureReason? == "RECOVERABLE_AGENT_OVERLOADED"
          or .failureSignal? == "AGENT_OVERLOADED"
          or .unavailableReason? == "AGENT_OVERLOADED"
          or .type? == "AGENT_OVERLOADED"
          or .type? == "RECOVERABLE_AGENT_OVERLOADED"
        )
      ' "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        printf 'provider_overloaded'
        return
      fi
    done < <(find "$runs_dir" -name run.json -type f | sort)
    printf ''
    return
  fi

  # Fallback keeps older environments usable but only matches typed JSON fields,
  # never free-form provider text.
  if grep -R -m 1 -E \
    '"failureReason"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"RECOVERABLE_PROVIDER_CONNECTION_FAILED"|"type"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"PROVIDER_CONNECTION_FAILED"|"failureSignal"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"PROVIDER_CONNECTION_FAILED"|"unavailableReason"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"PROVIDER_CONNECTION_FAILED"' \
    "$runs_dir" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'provider_connection_failed'
    return
  fi
  if grep -R -m 1 -E \
    '"failureReason"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"RECOVERABLE_AGENT_OVERLOADED"|"type"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"AGENT_OVERLOADED"|"type"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"RECOVERABLE_AGENT_OVERLOADED"|"failureSignal"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"AGENT_OVERLOADED"|"unavailableReason"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"AGENT_OVERLOADED"' \
    "$runs_dir" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'provider_overloaded'
    return
  fi
  printf ''
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# Deterministic preflight helpers for real provider case runners.

real_case_file_mtime_epoch() {
  local file="$1"
  [[ -f "$file" ]] || {
    printf ''
    return
  }
  if stat -f '%m' "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    stat -f '%m' "$file"
    return
  fi
  stat -c '%Y' "$file" 2>/dev/null || printf ''
}

real_case_latest_jvm_input_epoch() {
  local project_root="$1"
  [[ -n "$project_root" && -d "$project_root" ]] || {
    printf ''
    return
  }
  local latest=0 path mtime
  while IFS= read -r path; do
    mtime="$(real_case_file_mtime_epoch "$path")"
    [[ -n "$mtime" && "$mtime" -gt "$latest" ]] && latest="$mtime"
  done < <(
    {
      find "$project_root" -maxdepth 2 -name pom.xml -type f 2>/dev/null
      find "$project_root" -maxdepth 3 -path '*/src/main' -type d 2>/dev/null |
        while IFS= read -r dir; do
          find "$dir" -type f 2>/dev/null
        done
    } | sort
  )
  [[ "$latest" -gt 0 ]] && printf '%s' "$latest" || printf ''
}

real_case_artifact_freshness_status() {
  local skip_build="$1"
  local jar_path="$2"
  local build_started_epoch="$3"
  local latest_input_epoch="${4:-}"
  local mtime

  if [[ ! -f "$jar_path" ]]; then
    printf 'jar_missing'
    return
  fi
  mtime="$(real_case_file_mtime_epoch "$jar_path")"
  if [[ -z "$mtime" || -z "$build_started_epoch" ]]; then
    printf 'jar_mtime_unavailable'
    return
  fi
  if [[ "$skip_build" == "true" ]]; then
    if [[ -n "$latest_input_epoch" && "$mtime" -ge "$latest_input_epoch" ]]; then
      printf 'fresh_existing_artifact'
    else
      printf 'unproven_skip_build'
    fi
    return
  fi
  if [[ "$mtime" -ge "$build_started_epoch" ]]; then
    printf 'fresh'
    return
  fi
  if [[ -n "$latest_input_epoch" && "$mtime" -ge "$latest_input_epoch" ]]; then
    printf 'fresh_existing_artifact'
    return
  fi
  printf 'jar_not_fresh'
}

real_case_artifact_freshness_reason() {
  local status="$1"
  case "$status" in
    fresh)
      printf 'jar_mtime_is_after_build_start'
      ;;
    fresh_existing_artifact)
      printf 'jar_mtime_covers_project_inputs'
      ;;
    unproven_skip_build)
      printf 'skip_build_cannot_prove_current_code_is_in_the_executed_jar'
      ;;
    jar_missing)
      printf 'dualctl_jar_missing_after_build'
      ;;
    jar_mtime_unavailable)
      printf 'dualctl_jar_mtime_could_not_be_read'
      ;;
    jar_not_fresh)
      printf 'dualctl_jar_mtime_is_older_than_build_start'
      ;;
    *)
      printf 'unknown_freshness_status'
      ;;
  esac
}

real_case_artifact_freshness_is_valid() {
  [[ "$1" == "fresh" || "$1" == "fresh_existing_artifact" ]]
}

real_case_artifact_freshness_invalid_reason() {
  local status="$1"
  if real_case_artifact_freshness_is_valid "$status"; then
    printf ''
  elif [[ -n "$status" ]]; then
    printf 'artifact_freshness_%s' "$status"
  else
    printf 'artifact_freshness_unknown'
  fi
}

real_case_provider_probe_status() {
  local exit_code="$1"
  local result_json="$2"

  if [[ "$exit_code" == "124" ]]; then
    printf 'timeout'
    return
  fi
  if [[ "$exit_code" != "0" ]]; then
    printf 'failed'
    return
  fi
  if [[ ! -f "$result_json" ]]; then
    printf 'failed'
    return
  fi
  if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if jq -e '.is_error == true' "$result_json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      printf 'failed'
      return
    fi
    if jq -e '.type == "result"' "$result_json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      printf 'passed'
      return
    fi
    printf 'failed'
    return
  fi
  if grep -Eq '"is_error"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true' "$result_json"; then
    printf 'failed'
    return
  fi
  if grep -Eq '"type"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"result"' "$result_json"; then
    printf 'passed'
    return
  fi
  printf 'failed'
}

real_case_acpx_provider_probe_status() {
  local exit_code="$1"
  local transcript="$2"

  if [[ "$exit_code" == "124" ]]; then
    printf 'timeout'
    return
  fi
  if [[ "$exit_code" != "0" ]]; then
    printf 'failed'
    return
  fi
  if [[ ! -s "$transcript" ]]; then
    printf 'failed'
    return
  fi
  printf 'passed'
}

real_case_provider_probe_reason() {
  local status="$1"
  case "$status" in
    passed)
      printf 'provider_probe_completed'
      ;;
    skipped)
      printf 'provider_probe_disabled'
      ;;
    timeout)
      printf 'provider_probe_timed_out'
      ;;
    failed)
      printf 'provider_probe_failed'
      ;;
    *)
      printf 'provider_probe_unknown'
      ;;
  esac
}

real_case_provider_probe_is_valid() {
  [[ "$1" == "passed" ]]
}

real_case_provider_probe_invalid_reason() {
  local status="$1"
  case "$status" in
    failed|timeout|skipped)
      printf 'provider_preflight_%s' "$status"
      ;;
    *)
      printf ''
      ;;
  esac
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Workspace-bound eligibility evidence for real-case runs.

real_case_workspace_sha256_file() {
  shasum -a 256 "$1" | awk '{print $1}'
}

real_case_workspace_sha256_text() {
  printf '%s' "$1" | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}'
}

real_case_workspace_canonical_dir() {
  (cd "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 && pwd -P)
}

real_case_workspace_terminal_digest() {
  local workstream_id="$1"
  local workspace_id="$2"
  local workspace="$3"
  local head="$4"
  local tree="$5"
  local check_sha="$6"
  local exit_code="$7"
  local pre_status_sha="$8"
  local post_status_sha="$9"
  local stdout_sha="${10}"
  local stderr_sha="${11}"
  real_case_workspace_sha256_text "$(printf '%s\n' \
    "$workstream_id" \
    "$workspace_id" \
    "$workspace" \
    "$head" \
    "$tree" \
    "$check_sha" \
    "$exit_code" \
    "$pre_status_sha" \
    "$post_status_sha" \
    "$stdout_sha" \
    "$stderr_sha")"
}

real_case_workspace_resolve_identity() {
  local source_root="$1"
  local candidate_workspace="$2"
  local expected_workstream_id="$3"
  local canonical_source canonical_candidate workstream_json primary_workspace_id workspace_json
  local persisted_workstream_id persisted_git_root persisted_workspace_id workspace_workstream_id
  local original_workdir effective_workdir canonical_git_root canonical_original canonical_effective

  canonical_source="$(real_case_workspace_canonical_dir "$source_root")" || return 1
  canonical_candidate="$(real_case_workspace_canonical_dir "$candidate_workspace")" || return 1
  workstream_json="$canonical_candidate/.agent/workstreams/$expected_workstream_id/workstream.json"
  [[ -f "$workstream_json" ]] || return 1

  persisted_workstream_id="$(jq -er '.workstreamId | select(type == "string" and length > 0)' "$workstream_json" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  persisted_git_root="$(jq -er '.repository.gitRoot | select(type == "string" and length > 0)' "$workstream_json" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  primary_workspace_id="$(jq -er '.primaryWorkspaceId | select(type == "string" and length > 0)' "$workstream_json" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  [[ "$persisted_workstream_id" == "$expected_workstream_id" ]] || return 1
  canonical_git_root="$(real_case_workspace_canonical_dir "$persisted_git_root")" || return 1
  [[ "$canonical_git_root" == "$canonical_source" ]] || return 1

  workspace_json="$canonical_candidate/.agent/workstreams/$expected_workstream_id/workspaces/$primary_workspace_id.json"
  [[ -f "$workspace_json" ]] || return 1
  persisted_workspace_id="$(jq -er '.workspaceId | select(type == "string" and length > 0)' "$workspace_json" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  workspace_workstream_id="$(jq -er '.workstreamId | select(type == "string" and length > 0)' "$workspace_json" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  original_workdir="$(jq -er '.originalWorkdir | select(type == "string" and length > 0)' "$workspace_json" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  effective_workdir="$(jq -er '.effectiveWorkdir | select(type == "string" and length > 0)' "$workspace_json" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  [[ "$persisted_workspace_id" == "$primary_workspace_id" ]] || return 1
  [[ "$workspace_workstream_id" == "$expected_workstream_id" ]] || return 1
  canonical_original="$(real_case_workspace_canonical_dir "$original_workdir")" || return 1
  canonical_effective="$(real_case_workspace_canonical_dir "$effective_workdir")" || return 1
  [[ "$canonical_original" == "$canonical_source" ]] || return 1
  [[ "$canonical_effective" == "$canonical_candidate" ]] || return 1
  [[ "$(git -C "$canonical_effective" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" == "$canonical_effective" ]] || return 1

  REAL_CASE_RESOLVED_SOURCE_ROOT="$canonical_source"
  REAL_CASE_RESOLVED_WORKSPACE="$canonical_effective"
  REAL_CASE_RESOLVED_WORKSTREAM_ID="$persisted_workstream_id"
  REAL_CASE_RESOLVED_WORKSPACE_ID="$persisted_workspace_id"
  REAL_CASE_RESOLVED_WORKSTREAM_JSON="$workstream_json"
  REAL_CASE_RESOLVED_WORKSPACE_JSON="$workspace_json"
}

real_case_workspace_write_evidence() {
  local evidence="$1"
  local status="$2"
  local reason="$3"
  local verification_status="$4"
  local source_root="$5"
  local workstream_id="$6"
  local workspace_id="$7"
  local workspace="$8"
  local expected_head="$9"
  local expected_tree="${10}"
  local workspace_head="${11}"
  local workspace_tree="${12}"
  local check_path="${13}"
  local expected_check_sha="${14}"
  local actual_check_sha="${15}"
  local started_at="${16}"
  local finished_at="${17}"
  local exit_code="${18}"
  local stdout_path="${19}"
  local stderr_path="${20}"
  local pre_status_path="${21}"
  local post_status_path="${22}"
  local untracked_status_path="${23}"
  local terminal_digest="${24}"
  local tmp="$evidence.tmp"
  local stdout_sha="" stderr_sha="" pre_sha="" post_sha="" untracked_sha=""

  [[ -f "$stdout_path" ]] && stdout_sha="$(real_case_workspace_sha256_file "$stdout_path")"
  [[ -f "$stderr_path" ]] && stderr_sha="$(real_case_workspace_sha256_file "$stderr_path")"
  [[ -f "$pre_status_path" ]] && pre_sha="$(real_case_workspace_sha256_file "$pre_status_path")"
  [[ -f "$post_status_path" ]] && post_sha="$(real_case_workspace_sha256_file "$post_status_path")"
  [[ -f "$untracked_status_path" ]] && untracked_sha="$(real_case_workspace_sha256_file "$untracked_status_path")"

  jq -n \
    --arg status "$status" \
    --arg reason "$reason" \
    --arg verificationStatus "$verification_status" \
    --arg sourceRoot "$source_root" \
    --arg workstreamId "$workstream_id" \
    --arg workspaceId "$workspace_id" \
    --arg workspace "$workspace" \
    --arg expectedHead "$expected_head" \
    --arg expectedTree "$expected_tree" \
    --arg workspaceHead "$workspace_head" \
    --arg workspaceTree "$workspace_tree" \
    --arg checkPath "$check_path" \
    --arg expectedCheckSha256 "$expected_check_sha" \
    --arg checkSha256 "$actual_check_sha" \
    --arg startedAt "$started_at" \
    --arg finishedAt "$finished_at" \
    --argjson exitCode "$exit_code" \
    --arg stdoutPath "$stdout_path" \
    --arg stdoutSha256 "$stdout_sha" \
    --arg stderrPath "$stderr_path" \
    --arg stderrSha256 "$stderr_sha" \
    --arg preTrackedStatusPath "$pre_status_path" \
    --arg preTrackedStatusSha256 "$pre_sha" \
    --arg postTrackedStatusPath "$post_status_path" \
    --arg postTrackedStatusSha256 "$post_sha" \
    --arg postUntrackedStatusPath "$untracked_status_path" \
    --arg postUntrackedStatusSha256 "$untracked_sha" \
    --arg terminalDigest "$terminal_digest" \
    '{
      schemaVersion: 1,
      status: $status,
      reason: $reason,
      verificationStatus: $verificationStatus,
      sourceRoot: $sourceRoot,
      workstreamId: $workstreamId,
      workspaceId: $workspaceId,
      effectiveWorkdir: $workspace,
      expectedHead: $expectedHead,
      expectedTree: $expectedTree,
      workspaceHead: $workspaceHead,
      workspaceTree: $workspaceTree,
      checkPath: $checkPath,
      expectedCheckSha256: $expectedCheckSha256,
      checkSha256: $checkSha256,
      startedAt: $startedAt,
      finishedAt: $finishedAt,
      exitCode: $exitCode,
      stdoutPath: $stdoutPath,
      stdoutSha256: $stdoutSha256,
      stderrPath: $stderrPath,
      stderrSha256: $stderrSha256,
      preTrackedStatusPath: $preTrackedStatusPath,
      preTrackedStatusSha256: $preTrackedStatusSha256,
      postTrackedStatusPath: $postTrackedStatusPath,
      postTrackedStatusSha256: $postTrackedStatusSha256,
      postUntrackedStatusPath: $postUntrackedStatusPath,
      postUntrackedStatusSha256: $postUntrackedStatusSha256,
      terminalDigest: $terminalDigest,
      verifiedAt: ""
    }' >"$tmp" || return 1
  mv "$tmp" "$evidence"
}

real_case_workspace_preflight_capture() {
  local source_root="$1"
  local candidate_workspace="$2"
  local workstream_id="$3"
  local expected_head="$4"
  local expected_tree="$5"
  local check_path="$6"
  local expected_check_sha="$7"
  local evidence_dir="$8"
  local evidence="$evidence_dir/workspace-preflight.json"
  local stdout_path="$evidence_dir/workspace-preflight.stdout.log"
  local stderr_path="$evidence_dir/workspace-preflight.stderr.log"
  local pre_status_path="$evidence_dir/workspace-preflight.pre-tracked-status.txt"
  local post_status_path="$evidence_dir/workspace-preflight.post-tracked-status.txt"
  local untracked_status_path="$evidence_dir/workspace-preflight.post-untracked-status.txt"
  local started_at finished_at status="failed" reason="unknown" verification_status="not_run"
  local workspace="" workspace_id="" workspace_head="" workspace_tree="" actual_check_sha=""
  local exit_code=1 terminal_digest="" pre_status="" post_status=""

  mkdir -p "$evidence_dir" || return 1
  : >"$stdout_path"
  : >"$stderr_path"
  : >"$pre_status_path"
  : >"$post_status_path"
  : >"$untracked_status_path"
  started_at="$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"

  if ! real_case_workspace_resolve_identity "$source_root" "$candidate_workspace" "$workstream_id"; then
    reason="workspace_identity_invalid"
  else
    workspace="$REAL_CASE_RESOLVED_WORKSPACE"
    workspace_id="$REAL_CASE_RESOLVED_WORKSPACE_ID"
    workspace_head="$(git -C "$workspace" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
    workspace_tree="$(git -C "$workspace" rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ "$workspace_head" != "$expected_head" || "$workspace_tree" != "$expected_tree" ]]; then
      reason="workspace_git_identity_mismatch"
    elif [[ ! -f "$check_path" || ! -x "$check_path" ]]; then
      reason="check_missing_or_not_executable"
    else
      actual_check_sha="$(real_case_workspace_sha256_file "$check_path" 2>/dev/null || true)"
      if [[ -z "$actual_check_sha" || "$actual_check_sha" != "$expected_check_sha" ]]; then
        reason="check_sha_mismatch"
      else
        pre_status="$(git -C "$workspace" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=no 2>/dev/null || true)"
        printf '%s' "$pre_status" >"$pre_status_path"
        if [[ -n "$pre_status" ]]; then
          reason="pre_check_tracked_dirty"
        else
          if (
            cd "$workspace" || exit 125
            DUAL_WORKSTREAM_ID="$workstream_id" \
              DUAL_EXECUTION_WORKSPACE="$workspace" \
              "$check_path"
          ) >"$stdout_path" 2>"$stderr_path"; then
            exit_code=0
          else
            exit_code="$?"
          fi
          post_status="$(git -C "$workspace" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=no 2>/dev/null || true)"
          printf '%s' "$post_status" >"$post_status_path"
          git -C "$workspace" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all --ignored=matching \
            >"$untracked_status_path" 2>/dev/null || true
          if [[ "$exit_code" -ne 0 ]]; then
            reason="check_nonzero_exit"
          elif [[ -n "$post_status" ]]; then
            reason="post_check_tracked_dirty"
          else
            status="passed"
            reason="workspace_check_passed"
            verification_status="pending"
          fi
        fi
      fi
    fi
  fi

  finished_at="$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"
  terminal_digest="$(real_case_workspace_terminal_digest \
    "$workstream_id" "$workspace_id" "$workspace" "$workspace_head" "$workspace_tree" \
    "$actual_check_sha" "$exit_code" \
    "$(real_case_workspace_sha256_file "$pre_status_path")" \
    "$(real_case_workspace_sha256_file "$post_status_path")" \
    "$(real_case_workspace_sha256_file "$stdout_path")" \
    "$(real_case_workspace_sha256_file "$stderr_path")")"
  real_case_workspace_write_evidence \
    "$evidence" "$status" "$reason" "$verification_status" "$source_root" "$workstream_id" \
    "$workspace_id" "$workspace" "$expected_head" "$expected_tree" "$workspace_head" "$workspace_tree" \
    "$check_path" "$expected_check_sha" "$actual_check_sha" "$started_at" "$finished_at" "$exit_code" \
    "$stdout_path" "$stderr_path" "$pre_status_path" "$post_status_path" "$untracked_status_path" "$terminal_digest" || return 1
  [[ "$status" == "passed" ]]
}

real_case_workspace_preflight_mark_verify() {
  local evidence="$1"
  local status="$2"
  local reason="$3"
  local verification_status="$4"
  local verified_at tmp
  verified_at="$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"
  tmp="$evidence.tmp"
  jq \
    --arg status "$status" \
    --arg reason "$reason" \
    --arg verificationStatus "$verification_status" \
    --arg verifiedAt "$verified_at" \
    '.status = $status | .reason = $reason | .verificationStatus = $verificationStatus | .verifiedAt = $verifiedAt' \
    "$evidence" >"$tmp" || return 1
  mv "$tmp" "$evidence"
}

real_case_workspace_preflight_verify() {
  local evidence="$1"
  local source_root candidate_workspace workstream_id expected_head expected_tree check_path expected_check_sha
  local expected_workspace_id expected_workspace expected_terminal expected_post_sha expected_exit
  local workspace_head workspace_tree current_status current_status_sha actual_check_sha terminal_digest reason=""
  local expected_stdout_sha expected_stderr_sha actual_stdout_sha actual_stderr_sha stdout_path stderr_path

  [[ -f "$evidence" ]] || return 1
  [[ "$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$evidence" 2>/dev/null)" == "passed" ]] || return 1
  source_root="$(jq -er '.sourceRoot' "$evidence" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  candidate_workspace="$(jq -er '.effectiveWorkdir' "$evidence" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  workstream_id="$(jq -er '.workstreamId' "$evidence" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  expected_workspace_id="$(jq -er '.workspaceId' "$evidence" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  expected_workspace="$candidate_workspace"
  expected_head="$(jq -er '.expectedHead' "$evidence" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  expected_tree="$(jq -er '.expectedTree' "$evidence" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  check_path="$(jq -er '.checkPath' "$evidence" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  expected_check_sha="$(jq -er '.expectedCheckSha256' "$evidence" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  expected_terminal="$(jq -er '.terminalDigest' "$evidence" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  expected_post_sha="$(jq -er '.postTrackedStatusSha256' "$evidence" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  expected_exit="$(jq -er '.exitCode' "$evidence" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  stdout_path="$(jq -er '.stdoutPath' "$evidence" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  stderr_path="$(jq -er '.stderrPath' "$evidence" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  expected_stdout_sha="$(jq -er '.stdoutSha256' "$evidence" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  expected_stderr_sha="$(jq -er '.stderrSha256' "$evidence" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1

  if ! real_case_workspace_resolve_identity "$source_root" "$candidate_workspace" "$workstream_id"; then
    reason="pre_run_workspace_identity_changed"
  elif [[ "$REAL_CASE_RESOLVED_WORKSPACE_ID" != "$expected_workspace_id" || "$REAL_CASE_RESOLVED_WORKSPACE" != "$expected_workspace" ]]; then
    reason="pre_run_workspace_identity_changed"
  elif [[ ! -f "$check_path" ]]; then
    reason="pre_run_check_missing"
  else
    workspace_head="$(git -C "$expected_workspace" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
    workspace_tree="$(git -C "$expected_workspace" rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' 2>/dev/null || true)"
    current_status="$(git -C "$expected_workspace" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=no 2>/dev/null || true)"
    current_status_sha="$(real_case_workspace_sha256_text "$current_status")"
    actual_check_sha="$(real_case_workspace_sha256_file "$check_path" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    actual_stdout_sha="$(real_case_workspace_sha256_file "$stdout_path" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    actual_stderr_sha="$(real_case_workspace_sha256_file "$stderr_path" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    terminal_digest="$(real_case_workspace_terminal_digest \
      "$workstream_id" "$expected_workspace_id" "$expected_workspace" "$workspace_head" "$workspace_tree" \
      "$actual_check_sha" "$expected_exit" \
      "$(jq -r '.preTrackedStatusSha256' "$evidence")" "$current_status_sha" \
      "$actual_stdout_sha" "$actual_stderr_sha")"
    if [[ "$workspace_head" != "$expected_head" || "$workspace_tree" != "$expected_tree" ]]; then
      reason="pre_run_git_identity_changed"
    elif [[ -n "$current_status" || "$current_status_sha" != "$expected_post_sha" ]]; then
      reason="pre_run_tracked_status_changed"
    elif [[ "$actual_check_sha" != "$expected_check_sha" ]]; then
      reason="pre_run_check_sha_changed"
    elif [[ "$actual_stdout_sha" != "$expected_stdout_sha" || "$actual_stderr_sha" != "$expected_stderr_sha" ]]; then
      reason="pre_run_output_evidence_changed"
    elif [[ "$terminal_digest" != "$expected_terminal" ]]; then
      reason="pre_run_terminal_digest_changed"
    fi
  fi

  if [[ -n "$reason" ]]; then
    real_case_workspace_preflight_mark_verify "$evidence" "failed" "$reason" "failed" || true
    return 1
  fi
  real_case_workspace_preflight_mark_verify "$evidence" "passed" "workspace_check_verified_before_run" "passed"
}

real_case_workspace_preflight_usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage:
  real-case-workspace-preflight.sh capture --source-root <path> --workspace <path> --workstream <id> --expected-head <sha> --expected-tree <sha> --check <path> --expected-check-sha <sha> --evidence-dir <path>
  real-case-workspace-preflight.sh verify --evidence <workspace-preflight.json>
EOF
}

real_case_workspace_preflight_main() {
  local action="${1:-}"
  [[ -n "$action" ]] || { real_case_workspace_preflight_usage >&2; return 2; }
  shift
  local source_root="" workspace="" workstream="" expected_head="" expected_tree=""
  local check="" expected_check_sha="" evidence_dir="" evidence=""
  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --source-root) shift; source_root="${1:-}" ;;
      --workspace) shift; workspace="${1:-}" ;;
      --workstream) shift; workstream="${1:-}" ;;
      --expected-head) shift; expected_head="${1:-}" ;;
      --expected-tree) shift; expected_tree="${1:-}" ;;
      --check) shift; check="${1:-}" ;;
      --expected-check-sha) shift; expected_check_sha="${1:-}" ;;
      --evidence-dir) shift; evidence_dir="${1:-}" ;;
      --evidence) shift; evidence="${1:-}" ;;
      *) real_case_workspace_preflight_usage >&2; return 2 ;;
    esac
    shift
  done
  case "$action" in
    capture)
      [[ -n "$source_root" && -n "$workspace" && -n "$workstream" && -n "$expected_head" \
        && -n "$expected_tree" && -n "$check" && -n "$expected_check_sha" && -n "$evidence_dir" ]] || return 2
      real_case_workspace_preflight_capture "$source_root" "$workspace" "$workstream" "$expected_head" \
        "$expected_tree" "$check" "$expected_check_sha" "$evidence_dir"
      ;;
    verify)
      [[ -n "$evidence" ]] || return 2
      real_case_workspace_preflight_verify "$evidence"
      ;;
    *) real_case_workspace_preflight_usage >&2; return 2 ;;
  esac
}

if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "$0" ]]; then
  set -euo pipefail
  real_case_workspace_preflight_main "$@"
fi

scripts/lib/verification-gate.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# Verification Gate parser/validator for real provider runs.

verification_gate_field_value() {
  local file="$1"
  local field="$2"
  awk -v field="$field" '
    $0 ~ "^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*" field ":[[:space:]]*" {
      sub("^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*" field ":[[:space:]]*", "")
      print
      exit
    }
  ' "$file"
}

verification_gate_required_fields() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Target
Source of truth
Trigger precondition
How precondition is checked before run
PASS
FAIL
INVALID
Stop-loss
Run artifact freshness
EOF
}

verification_gate_missing_fields() {
  local file="$1"
  local missing=()
  local field value
  while IFS= read -r field; do
    [[ -n "$field" ]] || continue
    value="$(verification_gate_field_value "$file" "$field")"
    if [[ -z "$value" || "$value" == "TODO"* || "$value" == "TBD"* ]]; then
      missing+=("$field")
    fi
  done < <(verification_gate_required_fields)
  if [[ "${#missing[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    local IFS='|'
    printf '%s' "${missing[*]}"
  fi
}

verification_gate_tradeoff_flags() {
  local file="$1"
  local flags=()
  local field value lower
  while IFS= read -r field; do
    [[ -n "$field" ]] || continue
    value="$(verification_gate_field_value "$file" "$field")"
    lower="$(printf '%s' "$value" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
    if [[ "$lower" == *should* \
        || "$lower" == *probably* \
        || "$lower" == *maybe* \
        || "$lower" == *"run it and see"* \
        || "$lower" == *"looks bad"* \
        || "$lower" == *skip-build* \
        || "$lower" == *measure_only* \
        || "$lower" == *pricing_unknown* \
        || "$lower" == *not_applicable* \
        || "$lower" == *预计* \
        || "$lower" == *应该* \
        || "$lower" == *看看* \
        || "$lower" == *跑完再看* ]]; then
      flags+=("$field")
    fi
  done < <(verification_gate_required_fields)
  if [[ "${#flags[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    local IFS='|'
    printf '%s' "${flags[*]}"
  fi
}

verification_gate_is_complete() {
  local file="$1"
  [[ -f "$file" ]] || return 1
  [[ -z "$(verification_gate_missing_fields "$file")" ]]
  [[ -z "$(verification_gate_tradeoff_flags "$file")" ]]
}

- Source of truth: run.json
- Trigger precondition: provider configured
- How precondition is checked before run: inspect typed preflight
- PASS: required fields match
- FAIL: required fields do not match
- INVALID: freshness is unproven
- Stop-loss: stop before provider if preflight fails
- Run artifact freshness: preflight proves fresh jar
EOF

assert_eq "true" "$(verification_gate_is_complete "$complete" && printf true || printf false)" "complete gate"
assert_eq "run.json" "$(verification_gate_field_value "$complete" "Source of truth")" "field value"
assert_eq "" "$(verification_gate_missing_fields "$complete")" "no missing fields"

missing="$tmp/missing.md"
cat >"$missing" <<'EOF'
# Verification Gate

- Target: prove one thing
- Source of truth: run.json
- Trigger precondition: provider configured
EOF

assert_eq \
  "How precondition is checked before run|PASS|FAIL|INVALID|Stop-loss|Run artifact freshness" \
  "$(verification_gate_missing_fields "$missing")" \
  "missing fields"

todo="$tmp/todo.md"
cat >"$todo" <<'EOF'
# Verification Gate

- Target: TODO fill this
- Source of truth: run.json
- Trigger precondition: TBD
- How precondition is checked before run: inspect typed preflight
- PASS: required fields match
- FAIL: required fields do not match
- INVALID: freshness is unproven
- Stop-loss: stop before provider if preflight fails
- Run artifact freshness: preflight proves fresh jar
EOF

assert_eq \
  "Target|Trigger precondition" \
  "$(verification_gate_missing_fields "$todo")" \
  "todo fields"

weak="$tmp/weak.md"
cat >"$weak" <<'EOF'
# Verification Gate

- Target: prove provider-cache-aware
- Source of truth: metrics
- Trigger precondition: should trigger because cachedRead is high
- How precondition is checked before run: run it and see
- PASS: measure_only is visible
- FAIL: required fields do not match
- INVALID: pricing_unknown
- Stop-loss: stop if it looks bad
- Run artifact freshness: use --skip-build
EOF

assert_eq \
  "Trigger precondition|How precondition is checked before run|PASS|INVALID|Stop-loss|Run artifact freshness" \
  "$(verification_gate_tradeoff_flags "$weak")" \
  "weak verification fields rejected"
assert_eq "false" "$(verification_gate_is_complete "$weak" && printf true || printf false)" "weak gate rejected"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# prepare-public-benchmark-repo.sh — Copy a public benchmark sample into a
# disposable git repository that can be passed to run-real-case.sh.
#
# Usage:
#   ./scripts/prepare-public-benchmark-repo.sh
#   ./scripts/prepare-public-benchmark-repo.sh --dest /tmp/issue-flow-benchmark
#

set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
SOURCE_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/examples/issue-flow-app"
DEST_DIR=""

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage:
  prepare-public-benchmark-repo.sh [--dest <path>]

Options:
  --dest <path>  Destination directory. Defaults to a timestamped directory
                 under /tmp.
  -h, --help     Show this help.
EOF
}

parse_args() {
  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --dest)
        shift
        DEST_DIR="${1:-}"
        ;;
      -h|--help)
        usage
        exit 0
        ;;
      *)
        printf 'Unknown argument: %s\n' "$1" >&2
        usage
        exit 1
        ;;
    esac
    shift
  done
}

default_dest() {
  local stamp
  stamp="$(date -u '+%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')"
  printf '/tmp/dual-public-issue-flow-%s\n' "$stamp"
}

copy_sample() {
  [[ -d "$SOURCE_DIR" ]] || {
    printf 'Sample source not found: %s\n' "$SOURCE_DIR" >&2
    exit 1
  }

  if [[ -e "$DEST_DIR" ]]; then
    printf 'Destination already exists: %s\n' "$DEST_DIR" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"
  cp -R "$SOURCE_DIR"/. "$DEST_DIR"/
}

init_git_repo() {
  git -C "$DEST_DIR" init -b main >/dev/null
  git -C "$DEST_DIR" config user.name "dual benchmark"
  git -C "$DEST_DIR" config user.email "dual-benchmark@example.invalid"
  git -C "$DEST_DIR" add .
  git -C "$DEST_DIR" commit -m "chore: seed issue flow benchmark app" >/dev/null
}

print_next_steps() {
  cat <<EOF
Prepared public benchmark repo:
  $DEST_DIR

Run:
  ./scripts/run-real-case.sh \\
    --repo "$DEST_DIR" \\
    --task-file "$PROJECT_ROOT/docs/testing/real-case-benchmarks/cases/public-issue-flow-review-state.md" \\
    --variant full
EOF
}

main() {
  parse_args "$@"
  if [[ -z "$DEST_DIR" ]]; then
    DEST_DIR="$(default_dest)"
  fi
  copy_sample
  init_git_repo
  print_next_steps
}

main "$@"
scripts/real-case-benchmark-summary.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# real-case-benchmark-summary.sh — Build a markdown index from real-case summaries.
#
# This script does not run agents. It scans docs/testing/real-case-reports/*/summary.json
# and writes a compact benchmark index for comparing real lifecycle runs over time.
#
# Usage:
#   ./scripts/real-case-benchmark-summary.sh
#   ./scripts/real-case-benchmark-summary.sh --output /tmp/benchmark-index.md
#   ./scripts/real-case-benchmark-summary.sh --reports-dir docs/testing/real-case-reports
#

set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
REPORTS_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/docs/testing/real-case-reports"
OUTPUT="$PROJECT_ROOT/docs/testing/real-case-benchmarks/benchmark-index.md"
INCLUDE_PRIVATE=false

# shellcheck source=scripts/lib/real-case-grade.sh
source "$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/lib/real-case-grade.sh"

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage:
  real-case-benchmark-summary.sh [options]

Options:
  --reports-dir <path>  Directory containing */summary.json files.
  --output <path>       Markdown file to write. Default: docs/testing/real-case-benchmarks/benchmark-index.md
  --include-private     Include non-public local/private real-case summaries.
  --stdout              Print to stdout instead of writing a file.
  -h, --help            Show this help.
EOF
}

fail() {
  printf '[BENCHMARK][FAIL] %s\n' "$*" >&2
}

require_jq() {
  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
    fail "jq is required to aggregate benchmark summaries."
    fail "Install jq, then rerun this script."
    exit 1
  }
}

abs_path() {
  local path="$1"
  if [[ "$path" = /* ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$path"
  else
    printf '%s/%s\n' "$(pwd)" "$path"
  fi
}

parse_args() {
  local stdout=false
  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --reports-dir)
        shift
        REPORTS_DIR="$(abs_path "${1:-}")"
        ;;
      --output)
        shift
        OUTPUT="$(abs_path "${1:-}")"
        ;;
      --stdout)
        stdout=true
        ;;
      --include-private)
        INCLUDE_PRIVATE=true
        ;;
      -h|--help)
        usage
        exit 0
        ;;
      *)
        fail "Unknown argument: $1"
        usage
        exit 1
        ;;
    esac
    shift
  done
  if [[ "$stdout" == true ]]; then
    OUTPUT=""
  fi
}

json_files() {
  while IFS= read -r file; do
    if [[ "$INCLUDE_PRIVATE" == true ]] || is_public_summary "$file"; then
      printf '%s\n' "$file"
    fi
  done < <(find "$REPORTS_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name summary.json -type f | sort)
}

is_public_summary() {
  local file="$1"
  local task_file
  task_file="$(jq -r '.task_file // ""' "$file")"
  [[ "$(basename "$task_file")" == public-* ]]
}

json_value() {
  local file="$1"
  local query="$2"
  jq -r "$query // \"\"" "$file"
}

json_int() {
  local file="$1"
  local query="$2"
  local value
  value="$(jq -r "$query // 0" "$file")"
  [[ "$value" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || value=0
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
}

json_has_key() {
  local file="$1"
  local key="$2"
  jq -e --arg key "$key" 'has($key)' "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1
}

repair_loop_count() {
  local file="$1"
  if json_has_key "$file" "repair_loop_count"; then
    json_int "$file" '.repair_loop_count'
  else
    json_int "$file" '.acceptance_reject_count'
  fi
}

relative_ref() {
  local path="$1"
  if [[ "$path" == "$PROJECT_ROOT/"* ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "${path#"$PROJECT_ROOT/"}"
  else
    printf '%s\n' "$path"
  fi
}

artifact_health() {
  local file="$1"
  local missing
  missing="$(missing_artifacts "$file")"
  if [[ -z "$missing" ]]; then
    printf 'ok'
  else
    printf 'missing: %s' "$missing"
  fi
}

missing_artifacts() {
  local file="$1"
  jq -r '
    .artifacts // {}
    | to_entries
    | map(select(.value != true) | .key)
    | join(",")
  ' "$file"
}

case_name() {
  local file="$1"
  local task_file name
  task_file="$(json_value "$file" '.task_file')"
  if [[ -z "$task_file" ]]; then
    printf 'unknown'
    return
  fi
  name="$(basename "$task_file")"
  printf '%s' "${name%.*}"
}

benchmark_grade() {
  local file="$1"
  local status repo_clean missing_artifacts rejects decisions invalid
  status="$(json_value "$file" '.final_status')"
  repo_clean="$(json_value "$file" '.original_repo_clean')"
  missing_artifacts="$(missing_artifacts "$file")"
  rejects="$(json_int "$file" '.acceptance_reject_count')"
  decisions="$(jq -r '(.acceptance_decisions // []) | join(", ")' "$file")"
  invalid="$(json_value "$file" '.invalid_reason')"
  real_case_grade "$status" "$repo_clean" "$missing_artifacts" "$decisions" "$rejects" "$invalid"
}

benchmark_grade_reason() {
  local file="$1"
  local status repo_clean missing_artifacts rejects decisions invalid
  status="$(json_value "$file" '.final_status')"
  repo_clean="$(json_value "$file" '.original_repo_clean')"
  missing_artifacts="$(missing_artifacts "$file")"
  rejects="$(json_int "$file" '.acceptance_reject_count')"
  decisions="$(jq -r '(.acceptance_decisions // []) | join(", ")' "$file")"
  invalid="$(json_value "$file" '.invalid_reason')"
  real_case_grade_reason "$status" "$repo_clean" "$missing_artifacts" "$decisions" "$rejects" "$invalid"
}

confidence_from_decision() {
  local final_decision="$1"
  case "$final_decision" in
    ACCEPT) printf 'HIGH' ;;
    ACCEPT_WITH_NOTES) printf 'MEDIUM' ;;
    REJECT) printf 'LOW' ;;
    *) printf 'UNKNOWN' ;;
  esac
}

write_markdown() {
  local -a files=("$@")
  local total=${#files[@]}
  local completed=0
  local pass=0
  local pass_warn=0
  local fail_count=0
  local invalid_count=0
  local clean=0
  local reject_total=0
  local repair_total=0
  local gate_total=0
  local agent_total=0
  local generated_at
  generated_at="$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"

  for file in "${files[@]}"; do
    local grade
    grade="$(benchmark_grade "$file")"
    case "$grade" in
      PASS) pass=$((pass + 1)) ;;
      PASS-WARN) pass_warn=$((pass_warn + 1)) ;;
      INVALID) invalid_count=$((invalid_count + 1)) ;;
      FAIL) fail_count=$((fail_count + 1)) ;;
    esac
    [[ "$(json_value "$file" '.final_status')" == "COMPLETED" ]] && completed=$((completed + 1))
    [[ "$(json_value "$file" '.original_repo_clean')" == "true" ]] && clean=$((clean + 1))
    reject_total=$((reject_total + $(json_int "$file" '.acceptance_reject_count')))
    repair_total=$((repair_total + $(repair_loop_count "$file")))
    gate_total=$((gate_total + $(json_int "$file" '.gate_rounds')))
    agent_total=$((agent_total + $(json_int "$file" '.agent_run_count')))
  done

  cat <<EOF
# Real-case Benchmark Index

> Generated: $generated_at
> Source: $(relative_ref "$REPORTS_DIR")

## Aggregate

| Metric | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Runs | $total |
| PASS | $pass |
| PASS-WARN | $pass_warn |
| INVALID | $invalid_count |
| FAIL | $fail_count |
| Completed | $completed |
| Original repo clean | $clean |
| Acceptance rejects | $reject_total |
| Repair loops | $repair_total |
| Gate rounds | $gate_total |
| Agent runs | $agent_total |

## Runs

| Date | Case | Grade | Reason | Variant | Status | Workstream | Gates | Agent runs | Final acceptance | Repair loops | Confidence | Repo clean | Artifacts | Local report |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- | --- |
EOF

  for file in "${files[@]}"; do
    local run_dir date case variant status workstream gates agent_runs final_decision repair_loops confidence repo_clean artifacts grade reason
    run_dir="$(dirname "$file")"
    date="$(basename "$run_dir")"
    case="$(case_name "$file")"
    grade="$(benchmark_grade "$file")"
    reason="$(benchmark_grade_reason "$file")"
    variant="$(json_value "$file" '.variant')"
    status="$(json_value "$file" '.final_status')"
    workstream="$(json_value "$file" '.workstream')"
    gates="$(json_int "$file" '.gate_rounds')"
    agent_runs="$(json_int "$file" '.agent_run_count')"
    final_decision="$(json_value "$file" '.final_acceptance_decision')"
    if [[ -z "$final_decision" ]]; then
      final_decision="$(jq -r '(.acceptance_decisions // []) | last // "none"' "$file")"
    fi
    repair_loops="$(repair_loop_count "$file")"
    confidence="$(json_value "$file" '.verification_confidence')"
    [[ -n "$confidence" ]] || confidence="$(confidence_from_decision "$final_decision")"
    repo_clean="$(json_value "$file" '.original_repo_clean')"
    artifacts="$(artifact_health "$file")"
    printf '| %s | `%s` | %s | %s | %s | %s | `%s` | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | ignored local file |\n' \
      "$date" "$case" "$grade" "$reason" "$variant" "$status" "$workstream" "$gates" "$agent_runs" \
      "${final_decision:-none}" "$repair_loops" "$confidence" "$repo_clean" "$artifacts"
  done

  cat <<'EOF'

## How To Update

After running a real case:

```bash
./scripts/real-case-benchmark-summary.sh
```

Use this index to compare lifecycle health over time. It is not a replacement for reading the detailed report when a case fails or returns `PASS-WARN`.
EOF
}

main() {
  parse_args "$@"
  require_jq
  [[ -d "$REPORTS_DIR" ]] || { fail "reports directory not found: $REPORTS_DIR"; exit 1; }

  local files=()
  while IFS= read -r file; do
    files+=("$file")
  done < <(json_files)
  [[ ${#files[@]} -gt 0 ]] || { fail "no summary.json files found under $REPORTS_DIR"; exit 1; }

  if [[ -z "$OUTPUT" ]]; then
    write_markdown "${files[@]}"
    return
  fi

  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUTPUT")"
  local tmp
  tmp="$(mktemp "${OUTPUT}.tmp.XXXXXX")"
  write_markdown "${files[@]}" >"$tmp"
  mv "$tmp" "$OUTPUT"
  printf '[BENCHMARK] Wrote %s\n' "$OUTPUT"
}

main "$@"
scripts/run-public-benchmark.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# run-public-benchmark.sh — Prepare and run the reusable public benchmark case.
#
# This is the shortest public validation path for a real acpx lifecycle run.
# It creates a disposable issue-flow sample repo, then delegates the actual
# lifecycle to run-real-case.sh.
#
# Usage:
#   ./scripts/run-public-benchmark.sh
#   ./scripts/run-public-benchmark.sh --list-cases
#   ./scripts/run-public-benchmark.sh --case public-issue-flow-review-state
#   ./scripts/run-public-benchmark.sh --dest /tmp/dual-issue-flow-benchmark
#   DUAL_GLM_BASELINE_TOKENS=43540000 ./scripts/run-public-benchmark.sh --validation-target glm-token-attribution
#   ./scripts/run-public-benchmark.sh --skip-build --update-benchmark-index
#

set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
DEST_DIR=""
CASE_ID="public-issue-flow-review-state"
TASK_FILE=""
VARIANT="full"
PROMPT_LANGUAGE="auto"
MAX_STEPS=80
MAX_GATES=12
SKIP_BUILD=false
CLEANUP_WORKTREE=false
UPDATE_BENCHMARK_INDEX=false
SUITE_FILE="$PROJECT_ROOT/docs/testing/real-case-benchmarks/benchmark-suite.json"
VERIFICATION_GATE=""
VALIDATION_TARGET="lifecycle"
WORKSPACE_PREFLIGHT_CHECK=""

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage:
  run-public-benchmark.sh [options]

Options:
  --dest <path>             Destination sample repo. Defaults to /tmp.
  --case <id|path>          Public case id or task markdown path. Default: public-issue-flow-review-state.
  --list-cases              List public benchmark cases and exit.
  --variant <variant>       Workflow variant. Default: full.
  --prompt-language <auto|en|zh-CN>
                            Human-readable Agent output language. Default: auto.
  --max-steps <n>           Max nodes per run/approve. Default: 80.
  --max-gates <n>           Max human gates to auto-approve. Default: 12.
  --workspace-preflight-check <executable-script>
                            Forward a target-owned execution-workspace
                            eligibility check to run-real-case.sh.
  --skip-build              Forwarded to run-real-case.sh, which rejects real
                            provider runs when artifact freshness cannot be
                            proven.
  --cleanup-worktree        Remove the generated agent worktree after reporting.
  --update-benchmark-index  Refresh benchmark-index.md after the run.
  --validation-target <lifecycle|provider-model-attribution|zhipu-glm-console-calibration>
                            Verification target for the generated gate.
                            Default: lifecycle. provider-model-attribution is the
                            generic L1/L2 provider/model/usage/economics gate (no
                            baseline required). zhipu-glm-console-calibration is the
                            L3 GLM console reconciliation and requires
                            DUAL_GLM_BASELINE_TOKENS=<current GLM console total>.
                            glm-token-attribution is a deprecated alias for the latter.
  -h, --help                Show this help.

The script uses real acpx Claude/Codex sessions. It auto-approves human gates
for benchmark validation, so do not treat it as final product acceptance.
EOF
}

log() { printf '[PUBLIC-BENCH] %s\n' "$*"; }
fail() { printf '[PUBLIC-BENCH][FAIL] %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

require_jq() {
  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
    fail "jq is required for benchmark case selection."
    fail "Install jq, then rerun this script."
    exit 1
  }
}

list_cases() {
  require_jq
  jq -r '
    .cases[]
    | "- \(.id): \(.purpose) [\(.expected_grade)]"
  ' "$SUITE_FILE"
}

resolve_case() {
  require_jq
  if [[ "$CASE_ID" = /* || "$CASE_ID" == ./* || "$CASE_ID" == ../* ]]; then
    TASK_FILE="$CASE_ID"
    return
  fi

  local task variant steps gates
  task="$(jq -r --arg id "$CASE_ID" '.cases[] | select(.id == $id) | .task_file // ""' "$SUITE_FILE")"
  [[ -n "$task" ]] || {
    fail "unknown public benchmark case: $CASE_ID"
    fail "Run ./scripts/run-public-benchmark.sh --list-cases"
    exit 1
  }

  TASK_FILE="$PROJECT_ROOT/docs/testing/real-case-benchmarks/$task"
  variant="$(jq -r --arg id "$CASE_ID" '.cases[] | select(.id == $id) | .variant // ""' "$SUITE_FILE")"
  steps="$(jq -r --arg id "$CASE_ID" '.cases[] | select(.id == $id) | .max_steps // ""' "$SUITE_FILE")"
  gates="$(jq -r --arg id "$CASE_ID" '.cases[] | select(.id == $id) | .max_gates // ""' "$SUITE_FILE")"
  [[ -n "$variant" ]] && VARIANT="$variant"
  [[ -n "$steps" ]] && MAX_STEPS="$steps"
  [[ -n "$gates" ]] && MAX_GATES="$gates"
}

parse_args() {
  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --dest)
        shift
        DEST_DIR="${1:-}"
        ;;
      --case)
        shift
        CASE_ID="${1:-}"
        ;;
      --list-cases)
        list_cases
        exit 0
        ;;
      --variant)
        shift
        VARIANT="${1:-}"
        ;;
      --prompt-language)
        shift
        PROMPT_LANGUAGE="${1:-}"
        ;;
      --max-steps)
        shift
        MAX_STEPS="${1:-}"
        ;;
      --max-gates)
        shift
        MAX_GATES="${1:-}"
        ;;
      --workspace-preflight-check)
        shift
        WORKSPACE_PREFLIGHT_CHECK="${1:-}"
        ;;
      --skip-build)
        SKIP_BUILD=true
        ;;
      --cleanup-worktree)
        CLEANUP_WORKTREE=true
        ;;
      --update-benchmark-index)
        UPDATE_BENCHMARK_INDEX=true
        ;;
      --validation-target)
        shift
        VALIDATION_TARGET="${1:-}"
        ;;
      -h|--help)
        usage
        exit 0
        ;;
      *)
        fail "Unknown argument: $1"
        usage
        exit 1
        ;;
    esac
    shift
  done
}

public_benchmark_workspace_preflight_statement() {
  if [[ -n "$WORKSPACE_PREFLIGHT_CHECK" ]]; then
    printf 'Execution workspace eligibility is configured through --workspace-preflight-check %s; run-real-case.sh freezes its SHA-256, runs it in the persisted effective worktree, and verifies the resulting evidence before the first business Agent execution.' "$WORKSPACE_PREFLIGHT_CHECK"
  else
    printf 'Execution workspace eligibility proof is not configured for this legacy benchmark; source-checkout facts must not be described as proof of the persisted execution worktree.'
  fi
}

public_benchmark_append_workspace_preflight_arg() {
  [[ -n "$WORKSPACE_PREFLIGHT_CHECK" ]] || return 0
  args+=(--workspace-preflight-check "$WORKSPACE_PREFLIGHT_CHECK")
}

prepare_repo() {
  local output
  if [[ -n "$DEST_DIR" ]]; then
    output="$("$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/prepare-public-benchmark-repo.sh" --dest "$DEST_DIR")"
  else
    output="$("$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/prepare-public-benchmark-repo.sh")"
  fi

  printf '%s\n' "$output"
  DEST_DIR="$(printf '%s\n' "$output" | awk '/^  \/.*$/ { value = $1 } END { print value }')"
  [[ -n "$DEST_DIR" ]] || {
    fail "could not parse prepared benchmark repo path"
    exit 1
  }
}

validate_validation_target() {
  # Deprecated alias: glm-token-attribution -> zhipu-glm-console-calibration (L3 external reconciliation)
  if [[ "$VALIDATION_TARGET" == "glm-token-attribution" ]]; then
    log "[DEPRECATION] --validation-target glm-token-attribution is deprecated; use zhipu-glm-console-calibration."
    VALIDATION_TARGET="zhipu-glm-console-calibration"
  fi
  case "$VALIDATION_TARGET" in
    lifecycle) ;;
    provider-model-attribution) ;;
    zhipu-glm-console-calibration)
      [[ "${DUAL_GLM_BASELINE_TOKENS:-}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || {
        fail "DUAL_GLM_BASELINE_TOKENS=<integer token total> is required for --validation-target zhipu-glm-console-calibration"
        exit 1
      }
      ;;
    *)
      fail "--validation-target must be lifecycle, provider-model-attribution, or zhipu-glm-console-calibration"
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
}

public_benchmark_write_verification_gate() {
  local safe_case_id
  safe_case_id="$(printf '%s' "$CASE_ID" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' '_')"
  VERIFICATION_GATE="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/dual-verification-gate-${safe_case_id}.XXXXXX")"
  if [[ "$VALIDATION_TARGET" == "zhipu-glm-console-calibration" ]]; then
    cat >"$VERIFICATION_GATE" <<EOF
# Verification Gate: $CASE_ID / Zhipu GLM console calibration (L3 external reconciliation)

- Target: Validate GLM-5.2 provider token attribution for the public benchmark case $CASE_ID without using money as the acceptance metric.
- Source of truth: pre-run GLM console token total DUAL_GLM_BASELINE_TOKENS=${DUAL_GLM_BASELINE_TOKENS}, post-run GLM console token total captured after the run, workstream run.json providerModelIdentity, workstream-metrics.json tokenAttribution.perRun, and dualctl trace Token Attribution.
- Trigger precondition: DUAL_GLM_BASELINE_TOKENS is a numeric token total captured from the GLM console immediately before the run; disposable benchmark repo exists; task file exists; acpx is available; run-real-case.sh builds fresh artifacts; provider connectivity probe passes before workflow execution. $(public_benchmark_workspace_preflight_statement)
- How precondition is checked before run: run-public-benchmark.sh refuses this target unless DUAL_GLM_BASELINE_TOKENS is numeric; prepare-public-benchmark-repo.sh produced $DEST_DIR; run-real-case.sh validates repo, task file, acpx, variant, prompt language, this gate, preflight artifact freshness, and providerProbeStatus=passed before starting a workstream. Workspace eligibility is authoritative only when workspace-preflight.json records status=passed, verificationStatus=passed, and the persisted workspace identity.
- PASS: Workflow reaches COMPLETED; GLM provider runs in run.json and workstream-metrics.json preserve provider=zhipu, model=glm-5.2, billingMode=subscription_token_only, real input/output/cachedRead token counts, costAttribution.reliability=token_only, and providerCachePolicy.mode=token_policy_active; post-run GLM console token total minus DUAL_GLM_BASELINE_TOKENS matches the summed GLM totalTokens in metrics within the documented console bucket granularity.
- FAIL: Workflow does not complete, GLM provider/model/billingMode is wrong, real GLM token counts are missing or zero for completed provider runs, metrics and trace disagree on GLM totalTokens, or post-run GLM console delta contradicts summed GLM totalTokens beyond the documented console bucket granularity.
- INVALID: preflight artifact freshness is not proven, providerProbeStatus is not passed, a configured workspace eligibility check does not produce verified PASS evidence, DUAL_GLM_BASELINE_TOKENS was not captured immediately before this run, post-run GLM console total is not captured, the executed provider is not GLM-5.2 through Zhipu, required metrics/run.json/trace artifacts are missing, or this gate does not match the executed case.
- Stop-loss: Stop on provider preflight failure, start/autorun failure, missing providerModelIdentity after the first completed GLM run, or GLM console token delta exceeding 3,000,000 before acceptance; do not launch a second benchmark automatically.
- Run artifact freshness: run-real-case.sh builds dual-cli and dual-server before starting, then writes preflight.json proving the executed jar is fresh and recording provider probe evidence.
EOF
    return
  fi
  if [[ "$VALIDATION_TARGET" == "provider-model-attribution" ]]; then
    cat >"$VERIFICATION_GATE" <<EOF
# Verification Gate: $CASE_ID / Provider/Model usage & economics attribution

- Target: Validate provider/model/usage/economics attribution (L1 usage + L2 economics) for the public benchmark case $CASE_ID; provider-agnostic, not GLM-specific.
- Source of truth: run.json usage/providerModelIdentity/costAttribution; workstream-metrics.json tokenAttribution.perRun; dualctl trace Token Attribution.
- Trigger precondition: Disposable benchmark repo exists; task file exists; acpx is available; run-real-case.sh builds fresh artifacts; provider connectivity probe matches the actual runner kind and passes. $(public_benchmark_workspace_preflight_statement)
- How precondition is checked before run: prepare-public-benchmark-repo.sh produced $DEST_DIR; run-real-case.sh validates repo, task, acpx, variant, prompt language, this gate, preflight artifact freshness, expectedRunnerKind/providerProbeRunnerKind/providerProbePathMatchesExpected, and providerProbeStatus=passed before starting a workstream. Workspace eligibility is authoritative only when workspace-preflight.json records status=passed, verificationStatus=passed, and the persisted workspace identity.
- PASS: At least one provider run has measurementType=PROVIDER_RUN_USAGE (not an artifact estimate); provider/model identity is preserved or carries a typed unknown reason; input/output/cache-read/cache-write/total token counts are not zero for completed provider runs; known provider routes through the catalog (zhipu subscription token-only; DeepSeek cache pricing; Anthropic full pricing; OpenAI/Codex catalog); unknown provider preserves tokens with an explicit pricing-unknown state and is never zeroed; billingMode/costAttribution.reliability/providerCachePolicy.mode are consistent with the catalog; run.json/metrics/trace do not contradict each other.
- FAIL: Provider run usage exists but tokens are zeroed; provider/model identity is lost without a typed reason; known provider does not route through the catalog; billingMode is wrong; metrics/trace/run.json are contradictory; an artifact estimate is disguised as provider usage.
- INVALID: Preflight artifact freshness is not proven; providerProbePathMatchesExpected is false; providerProbeStatus is not passed; a configured workspace eligibility check does not produce verified PASS evidence; no provider run started; provider usage is unavailable without a typed unavailableReason; stale jar; or this gate does not match the executed case.
- Stop-loss: Stop on provider preflight failure, start/autorun failure, or WAITING_FOR_RECOVERY; do not launch a second benchmark automatically.
- Run artifact freshness: run-real-case.sh builds dual-cli and dual-server before starting, then writes preflight.json proving the executed jar is fresh and recording provider probe evidence including expectedRunnerKind, providerProbeRunnerKind, and providerProbePathMatchesExpected.
EOF
    return
  fi
  cat >"$VERIFICATION_GATE" <<EOF
# Verification Gate: $CASE_ID

- Target: Run the public benchmark case $CASE_ID through the full dual lifecycle with real acpx agents.
- Source of truth: Generated report summary.json, workstream ledger, run.json, workstream-metrics.json, and dualctl trace for the created workstream.
- Trigger precondition: Disposable benchmark repo exists, task file exists, acpx is available, run-real-case.sh builds fresh artifacts, and provider connectivity probe passes before workflow execution. $(public_benchmark_workspace_preflight_statement)
- How precondition is checked before run: prepare-public-benchmark-repo.sh produced $DEST_DIR; run-real-case.sh validates repo, task file, acpx, variant, prompt language, this gate, preflight artifact freshness, and providerProbeStatus=passed before starting a workstream. Workspace eligibility is authoritative only when workspace-preflight.json records status=passed, verificationStatus=passed, and the persisted workspace identity.
- PASS: Workflow reaches COMPLETED, original repo stays clean, key artifacts exist, final acceptance is ACCEPT or ACCEPT_WITH_NOTES, and trace/metrics can explain execution/token state.
- FAIL: Workflow does not complete, original repo is polluted, required report/handoff/delivery artifacts are missing, or acceptance rejects without expected repair evidence.
- INVALID: preflight artifact freshness is not proven, providerProbeStatus is not passed, a configured workspace eligibility check does not produce verified PASS evidence, provider/model/token attribution fields are missing for a token benchmark target, or this gate does not match the executed case.
- Stop-loss: The script stops on start/autorun failure and writes local evidence; do not launch a second benchmark automatically.
- Run artifact freshness: run-real-case.sh builds dual-cli and dual-server before starting, then writes preflight.json proving the executed jar is fresh and recording provider probe evidence.
EOF
}

run_case() {
  resolve_case
  [[ -f "$TASK_FILE" ]] || {
    fail "task file not found: $TASK_FILE"
    exit 1
  }

  local -a args=(
    --repo "$DEST_DIR"
    --task-file "$TASK_FILE"
    --variant "$VARIANT"
    --prompt-language "$PROMPT_LANGUAGE"
    --max-steps "$MAX_STEPS"
    --max-gates "$MAX_GATES"
  )
  [[ "$SKIP_BUILD" == true ]] && args+=(--skip-build)
  [[ "$CLEANUP_WORKTREE" == true ]] && args+=(--cleanup-worktree)
  [[ "$UPDATE_BENCHMARK_INDEX" == true ]] && args+=(--update-benchmark-index)
  public_benchmark_append_workspace_preflight_arg

  validate_validation_target
  public_benchmark_write_verification_gate
  args+=(--verification-gate "$VERIFICATION_GATE")

  log "Running public benchmark against: $DEST_DIR"
  log "Case: $CASE_ID"
  log "Task file: $TASK_FILE"
  log "Variant: $VARIANT, max steps: $MAX_STEPS, max gates: $MAX_GATES"
  log "Prompt language: $PROMPT_LANGUAGE"

  # Derive the workflow's actual acpx runner kind so the preflight probe matches it.
  # Java/domain owns this derivation; run-real-case.sh only records + matches it.
  local runner_jar="$PROJECT_ROOT/dual-cli/target/dual-cli-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar"
  if [[ "$SKIP_BUILD" != true ]]; then
    log "Building dual-cli to derive expected runner kind..."
    (cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" && mvn -pl dual-cli -am package -DskipTests -q) || {
      fail "failed to build dual-cli for runner-kind derivation"
      exit 1
    }
  fi
  local expected_kind
  expected_kind="$(java -jar "$runner_jar" runner-kind --variant "$VARIANT" 2>/dev/null | awk '/^runner-kind:/ {print $2; exit}')"
  if [[ -z "$expected_kind" || "$expected_kind" == "unknown" ]]; then
    fail "could not derive a known runner kind via 'dualctl runner-kind --variant $VARIANT' (got: '${expected_kind:-<empty>}')"
    exit 1
  fi
  log "Derived expected runner kind: $expected_kind (variant $VARIANT)"
  args+=(--expected-runner-kind "$expected_kind")

  "$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/run-real-case.sh" "${args[@]}"
}

main() {
  parse_args "$@"
  prepare_repo
  run_case
}

if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "$0" ]]; then
  main "$@"
fi
